subject: CascadeWorks vendor setup — onboarding checklist + payment lanes
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@cascadeworks.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@cascadeworks.com
Date: 2025-05-20T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: CascadeWorks vendor setup — onboarding checklist + payment lanes

Hi Soojin / Ben,

Thanks for the welcome call this morning. We're ready to get CascadeWorks set up in Redwood's vendor system so we can start billing for the integration work next month. A few operational items to align on before we complete our onboarding packet: 

- Payment terms: CascadeWorks' preferred terms are Net 45. We can be flexible, but we'd like to understand Redwood's default cadence and any early-pay options.
- First-invoice timing: our team will submit an initial invoice for a project kickoff retainer. Can Redwood accelerate the first remittance (we can accept an electronic ACH payment) if PO + vendor activation complete?
- PO / invoice mapping: We need a PO field that maps to a custom "project-code" on invoices (three-letter project code + 5-digit number). Is that possible?
- Split invoicing: We will bill two Redwood business units on separate line items. Can your system accept split invoices, or do we need two separate invoices / vendor records?

Attached: CascadeWorks_W9.pdf and bank letter for ACH setup. We'll also complete whatever vendor onboarding form you provide.

Appreciate a short checklist and any form links we should complete.

Best,
Elena Park
Director, Finance Ops
CascadeWorks LLC

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@cascadeworks.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2025-05-20T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CascadeWorks vendor setup — onboarding checklist + payment lanes

Hi Elena — great to meet earlier. Thanks for sending the W9 and bank letter.

Quick answers and next steps:

1) Default terms: Redwood vendor default is Net 30. If Net 45 is required, we can accommodate but will need a one-time PO routing note so Finance knows to set the vendor account to Net 45.
2) Early remittance for first invoice: Finance can prioritize a single onboarding invoice for early ACH remittance once: (a) PO is issued and approved, (b) vendor onboarding form + bank attestation are returned, and (c) merchant agreement (e-sign) is completed. We typically require 5 business days from PO activation to process expedited ACH. If you need faster, we can offer an early-pay enrollment at a 1.5% fee on that invoice.
3) Project-code PO field: We support custom PO metadata fields; please indicate the exact field name you expect ("project-code" is fine). We'll confirm mapping so the code appears in remittance files.
4) Split invoicing: You can send a single invoice with split line items as long as each line item includes the intended business unit / GL code. Finance requires the invoice PDF to show the allocation or you may submit two invoices.

Action items:
- I've attached our vendor onboarding form (redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf). Please complete and return.
- If you want early-pay for the first invoice, reply here and we'll route to Ben for enrollment and DocuSign.

I'll loop Marissa from Procurement to advise on PO metadata and the routing note.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Vendor Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf

From: Elena Park <elena.park@cascadeworks.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2025-05-20T15:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CascadeWorks vendor setup — onboarding checklist + payment lanes

Thanks Soojin — attached is the completed onboarding form and the bank attestation (see cascadeworks_bank_letter.pdf).

We will opt in to the early-pay for the first invoice if that speeds the kickoff funding — please send the DocuSign and fee details. Confirming our preferred PO metadata field name is exactly: project-code. Example PO value: "CWS-74213".

Regarding split billing: we'll submit a single invoice with two line items and include the Redwood BU names and GL codes on the PDF. If Finance prefers separate invoices we can do that, but streamlined single invoice is ideal.

One additional question: do you have a supplier portal where we can upload invoices and check PO status, or is email enough? Our team uses a procurement portal but we can adapt.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Hi Elena — looping in Finance confirmation and next steps.

Short version: we can do Net 45 (we'll flag vendor account), support the custom PO metadata mapping for "project-code", and accept a single invoice with split line items if the BU allocation is shown on the PDF.

For early-pay on the first invoice:
- Please review & sign the attached merchant enrollment DocuSign (link: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABC-Enrollment-Link).
- Once signed and PO is activated, we run an expedited ACH that typically completes within 3 business days (we'll waive the standard 5 business-day queue for enrolled vendors). The early-pay fee is 1.5% on the invoice value; we will deduct that from the remittance.

Operational checklist for your team to close this out: 
1) Return signed redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (attached by Soojin).
2) Sign DocuSign merchant enrollment (link above).
3) Confirm sample invoice PDF that shows split line items and BU/GL allocation (send to finance@redwood.com).
4) Provide final PO number and indicate the project-code format.

We do not currently provide a public supplier portal for external vendors; invoice uploads via email to finance@redwood.com are standard. We plan to enable a portal next quarter.

If you'd like I can schedule a 20-minute touchpoint tomorrow to verify the completed items and activation timeline.

Thanks — Ben Carter
Senior Manager, Accounts Payable
Redwood Inference

Attachment: merchant_enrollment_docusign (link in body)
